scope: Small causal pilot from the retained step-2000 Q and Adam. All six depth-1 goals plus one allowed complete orbit each at depth 2 and 3. Reverse simulator BFS supplies exact labels; the existing distance adapter must agree. Main arms match unique decisions, exact goal exposure stream, loss weights, updates and replay. Layer sampling balances available distance strata within each goal; ordinary sampling balances goals but draws uniformly from its physical-parent pool. Micro contains shared hard parents plus one admissible seed per available near-to-far layer and is an overfitting diagnostic without replay, never a candidate. No auxiliary edge or geometry losses.
split: Retain all old state/axis/goal-orbit exclusions. Micro development stars and their axis closures are excluded from every pilot pool; their start stars also avoid micro training start-star axis closure. Shortest-path diagnostics censor protected stars and exclude protected pair labels; report the available path coverage.
budget: 2048 updates per main arm, staged diagnostics every 256; separate micro fit diagnostic 8192 updates with checks every 512. Expand only after fitting and independent validation evidence. Sealed tests stay closed through development. Frozen FLAN map unchanged.
